transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-11-01
Time: 10:00 AM PT
Duration: ~57 minutes
Location: All-hands (Zoom)
Attendees: Full company

Summary (auto): Leadership gave updates on Dedicated GA, Private deployments, SOC 2 timeline, hiring. Q&A covered on-prem support, billing, and partner integrations.

[00:00] Sofia: All right, hey everybody, welcome to our November all hands. i'm Sofia, i'll keep this brief, then Marcus and Priya will take you through product and eng, and Jenna has a couple people ops notes. Thanks for joining, especially those on late timezones.

[00:18] Marcus: Quick housekeeping — video will be recorded, post the notes and the deck on confluence, link in slack. Uh, couple headlines: Dedicated GA is on track for mid-November, we have the last compliance gates to close.

[00:35] Priya: From product side, GA means we expose the new autoscale and burst policies, plus rollout flags for model pinning. We'll have a migration guide for current Dedicated customers. There's a runbook — we'll share later.

[00:52] Daniel: Technical detail — we've validated multi-GPU inference on A100 and H100 clusters with the new kernel selector. In a lot of workloads we're seeing 20-35% improvement in throughput when batching is enabled. Caveat: long context lengths still need more optimization, but KV cache improvements landed last sprint.

[01:20] Audience: (muted) applause/emoji

[01:25] Sofia: Okay quick finance note — ARR up 28% year over year, runway comfortable, but we need to be disciplined on units as we scale. That ties to Redwood Optimize: get more bang per token.

[01:45] Jenna: Hiring — we are focusing on infra SRE, SE for enterprise, two product managers, and compliance engineer. Expect to see interview panels in 2 weeks. Please keep referrals coming.

[02:05] Priya: Roadmap bullets — Dedicated GA, Private deployment v1.2 (VPC routing and KMS integration), and Console improvements: per-route cost breakdowns and rollout UX. The Private package will include optional on-prem installer for air-gapped customers, still in beta.

[02:32] Marcus: Security update — SOC 2 readiness has a few outstanding items: audit logs retention policy, key rotation docs for KMS/HSM, and RBAC audit trails. We're aiming to schedule the auditor in mid-November, target report by end of year.

[02:55] Sofia: Can you unpack RBAC concerns quickly?

[03:00] Marcus: Yeah, there's a small gap around delegated admin roles for Private deployments — we need a clearer mapping of cloud IAM to our RBAC. Security team will produce a mapping doc.

[03:18] Priya: On customer-facing side we have a couple big pilot wins: one fintech customer is moving to Dedicated for latency SLAs, and a healthcare group is evaluating Private for data residency. We'll coordinate sales and SE for those POCs.

[03:40] Audience question (via chat): Will Dedicated GA support quantized weights out of the box?

[03:48] Daniel: Short answer: yes for common quant profiles. We have two quant profiles tested across MPT and Llama-like models; full coverage is ongoing. Performance numbers vary by model. We'll publish the benchmark sheet.

[04:05] Sofia: Great, and on the commercial side — pricing for Dedicated will remain usage + reserved commit options. We will publish example unit economics so teams and customers can plan. Marketing to publish pricing examples and a calculator.

[04:28] Jenna: Important people ops note — holiday schedule and comp review timeline. End of year comp calibration is coming, managers please submit calibration forms by 2026-11-20. Also please fill out the engagement pulse survey. Anonymous.

[04:48] Priya: Quick demo snippet — (screen share glitch) sorry, small hiccup, switching. Ok showing the rollout UI: you can set canary percent, fallback models, and tie to latency SLOs. We did get feedback that the UX for pinning model versions was confusing, so we simplified it.

[05:20] Marcus: A couple product engineering calls to note: SEs, we'll run a cross-team dry-run of Dedicated deploys on 11/6. This is internal only — want to validate rollback, metrics, and billing hooks. Ops please be on call.

[05:40] Audience: (someone off mic) Are we covering bulk migrations for existing dedicated customers?

[05:46] Priya: Yes, we'll provide migration scripts and a migration plan doc. AE and SE will coordinate with customers for scheduled windows.

[06:05] Marcus: On reliability: we've added pre-emptible node fallback and model-variant routing — so if a high-perf variant is unavailable, we route to a compatible quantized variant to maintain availability. It's not perfect for all workloads but the fallback reduces 99th pct outages in tests.

[06:30] Daniel: There's a note about tracing hooks — we've added request-level tracing into the Console, but we need to tighten PII scrubbers before GA; privacy-first default enabled though.

[06:48] Sofía (typo in transcript sometimes spelled Sofia vs Sofía): quick shoutout, engineering shipped the KV cache improvements last sprint, that was a big lift.

[07:05] Marcus: Financial ask — as we approach GA we may need a small marketing budget for the customer webinar and paid benchmarks. Working with finance to approve.

[07:20] Audience question: what's the plan for on-prem installers?

[07:25] Priya: Beta 1 will be an installable docker-compose/helm package for air-gapped infra. It won't have full Console feature parity on day-one but will include inference runtime and basic monitoring + KMS hooks. We are prioritizing security and auditability.

[07:55] Marcus: Also note partner integrations — we're continuing discussions with a few HCI vendors and cloud partners for Marketplace listings. That will help regulated customers get started faster.

[08:10] Audience: (someone interrupts) Any update on partnerships with GPU providers?

[08:15] Daniel: We're in talks with a couple hardware partners; nothing public yet. The focus is on optimizing kernels for H100 families and ensuring scheduling works well across both GPU and CPU fallback.

[08:40] Sofia: Ok, Q&A open. Please put questions in chat. One question about SOC 2: will Private customers get a separate report?

[08:50] Marcus: For Private customers we will provide an SOC 2 summary and a letter of attestation. For on-prem we will provide deployment guidance and artifacts to help customers include Redwood in their scope.

[09:05] Audience: (from product) How do we measure success for GA?

[09:12] Priya: Success metrics: sub-100ms median for small-text workloads, 99.9% uptime for Dedicated pools, migration of at least 3 pilot customers to GA, and no critical SOC 2 findings. Those are in the OKRs doc.

[09:30] Jenna: People question — as we hire more senior ICs, we are moving to a 2x interview loop for principal roles. Please synchronize with People Ops for panels.

[09:45] Marcus: small technical aside — a call-out for infra about cost tracking: token-level cost attribution is live in staging, we need a couple more hooks before GA for reserved commit accounting.

[10:10] Daniel: we'll also start a weekly postmortem review for any infra incidents during the GA window — lean and fast. Engineers please sign up for on-call rotations.

[10:30] Sofia: Last thing, big thanks to folks shipping the Dedicated features and to security for pushing SOC 2. We'll have a company town hall after GA to celebrate.

[10:42] Sofia: Recap of action items and owners — Priya to share runbook, Daniel to publish benchmarks, Marcus and security to push audit timeline, Jenna to post hiring priorities.

[10:56] Sofia: Ok that's it, thanks everyone. We'll post the recording and the deck. Have a good week.

(Recording ends)
